newsitem.title: USA: General Signal's Best Power to cut jobs.
newsitem.headline: General Signal's Best Power to cut jobs.

text.p: Best Power, a unit of General Signal Corp, said Thursday it will cut 16 percent of its worldwide workforce in a restructuring involving a move of of the company's headquarters to Necedah, Wis., from Dallas.
The maker of power systems said it will chop 202 jobs, 176 of which are in Necedah. The restructuring also involves an unspecified number of job reassignments.
"Relocating our company headquarters to Necedah is a very positive and important move for our company," said John Paul, president of Best Power.

"Our primary U.S. operations are here, and we have a long history in Central Wisconsin. We can now concentrate our operations, resources, and major production facilities in Necedah, where the company was founded more than 20 years ago," he said.
Best Power designs and manufactures power protection equipment for applications where the quality and consistency of electrical power is crucial.
